experiment_data.hypothesis: The BCS-accuracy correlation observed in FewRel BCS-controlled experiments (R²=0.22-0.53) is robust across random seeds. If seed=123 and seed=456 replicate the negative BCS-accuracy correlation direction and significance observed with seed=42, this confirms the finding is not a single-seed artifact. Rebuttal material for R15-W2 single-seed concern.

spec.note: 50 batches x 3 shot conditions x 2 seeds = 300 batches total. Started via nohup (worker bypassed submit_training_job).
